title: SEM mapping of sequence-specific protein-DNA interactions on long DNA molecules.
authors: Noh, Chanyoung; Lee, Sangwon; Kang, Yoonjung; Kim, Taesoo; Yun, Taebin; Kim, Yoojin; Park, Gyuri; Sundharbaabu, Priyannth R; Shim, Sang-Hee; Lim, Kwang-Il; Lee, Jung Heon; Jo, Kyubong
one_liner_zh: 该文用扫描电镜结合序列标记和机器学习检测单分子DNA上的蛋白结合位置，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作定位，但核心是成像方法而非TF-DNA结合机制建模，AI仅用于辅助检测，方法可迁移性有限。
abstract: Direct visualization of protein-binding positions along individual DNA molecules provides direct readouts of binding location, occupancy, and heterogeneity beyond the reach of ensemble assays. However, existing single-molecule imaging methods face a persistent trade-off between spatial resolution, field of view, and throughput. Here, we establish an scanning electron microscopy (SEM)-based approach that combines contrast enhancement with sequence-defined labeling to image extended DNA molecules and resolve protein-bound regions along their contour. We validate this capability across distinct binding regimes, including sequence-defined streptavidin-fluorescent protein labels on biotinylated lambda DNA, mapping of densely bound dCas9 regions on plasmid DNA, and machine-learning-assisted detection of localized dCas9 binding on human genomic DNA (F1 = 0.97). SEM achieves mean positional offsets of 410 +/- 325 bp for nick-translated labels and 116 +/- 63 bp for dCas9-bound regions, ~3-fold improved over fluorescence imaging, while supporting large-area surveys of extended DNA molecules across multi-scale magnifications-a capability not accessible by transmission electron microscopy or atomic force microscopy. These results establish SEM as a scalable platform for simultaneous structural visualization and quantitative mapping of sequence-specific DNA-protein interactions along individual DNA molecules.
abstract_zh: 沿单个DNA分子直接可视化蛋白质结合位置，可提供结合位点、占据率和异质性的直接读数，这超出了群体测定的能力范围。然而，现有的单分子成像方法在空间分辨率、视野和通量之间面临持续权衡。在此，我们建立了一种基于扫描电子显微镜 (scanning electron microscopy, SEM) 的方法，该方法结合对比度增强和序列定义标记，对延伸的DNA分子进行成像，并沿其轮廓解析蛋白质结合区域。我们在不同结合模式下验证了此能力，包括生物素化λ DNA上的序列定义链霉亲和素-荧光蛋白标记、质粒DNA上密集结合dCas9区域的作图，以及机器学习辅助检测人类基因组DNA上的局部dCas9结合（F1 = 0.97）。SEM对切口平移标记实现平均位置偏移为410 ± 325 bp，对dCas9结合区域为116 ± 63 bp，较荧光成像提升约3倍，同时支持跨多尺度放大倍数的大面积延伸DNA分子调查——这是透射电子显微镜或原子力显微镜无法实现的能力。这些结果确立了SEM作为可扩展平台，用于沿单个DNA分子同时进行结构可视化和序列特异性DNA-蛋白质相互作用的定量作图。
